senses.gloss: f. pl. (denom. of גדרה fold, Num. XXXII, 16) animals living in folds (which they leave in day-time), in gen. moving live stock.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 36a:9">B. Bath. 36ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Gittin 20b:15">Gitt. 20ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 84b:10">Keth. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>הג׳ אין להם חזקה</he> the possession of fold-animals is no evidence of ownership (as they may have come over by accident).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 69a:9">B. Mets. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>בג׳ כ״ד חדש</he> fold-animals (small cattle given out for raising on half-profit) must be attended to twenty four months (before a division of profits can be demanded by the keeper).
